description.value: Perry's Pizza and Grill is a long-established Cranbrook restaurant that started in Kimberley's Platzl in 1988 and relocated to Cranbrook in 2004. The menu centres on fresh daily-made dough pizzas, house-made burgers on Kaiser buns, pasta, and salads, with catering and online ordering available. A convenient stop for touring cyclists needing a filling sit-down or takeout meal in central Cranbrook.
